result:
The decision is **CONTINUE**: round 394 fixes three Medium bugs in the library preview streaming that shipped in round 393.

**Round 393 result.** C passed it with browser checks at both viewports (`browserVerified` true, 0 bugs), and gate 393 published commit `1091b9e`. On that evidence, PERF-13c-i is marked done. The old task is copied to `tasks/round-393.md` (identical), and the backlog is now v361 (D-29z1342…D-29z1346).

**Round 394 = PERF-13c-ii-a.** A changes only `preview.client.ts`, its test file and doc 252. `ArrangementContext.tsx` stays untouched, and a claims check enforces that. Baseline is `1091b9e`, clean.

| Bug | What happens at HEAD (I reproduced it in the browser) | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| REV-B393-M1-STALL | If the audio file never arrives, the Preview button stays on "Stop" forever and nothing plays | An 8 s stall timer, reset while bytes still arrive; on expiry it falls back to the existing decode path. On my draft fix this took 8.4 s, decoded once and made no extra downloads after the switch |
| GATE393-M1-SYNC-THROW | Setting the play position or calling `play()` can throw, leaving "Stop" on silence | The throw takes the same fallback route instead of escaping |
| A-R393-REVIEW-M1-EXTERNAL-PAUSE | A media key or the OS pausing the audio leaves "Stop" and a frozen cursor | The preview ends and the button returns to "Preview" |

- **External pause re-rated to Medium.** I had it as Low. A's reviewer is right that it is reachable: the audio shows up in Chrome's and the OS's media controls, so any media key hits it. It is now fixed in this round instead of waiting in the deferred list.
- **NotAllowedError change dropped.** It was planned to stop falling back to decode when the browser blocks playback. tech-lead pointed out that on Safari/iOS the fallback is what produces sound, so the current behaviour stays.
- **Not fixed, recorded:** a stream that keeps trickling bytes but never starts playing will not trip the timer. It is listed in the task and goes into doc 252.

**What I checked on a draft fix (scratch copy, `store/` untouched):** it typechecks and passes Biome. The 14 related test files (256 tests) pass. All 12 deliberate code breaks turn the new tests red. A browser probe at both viewports showed the stall fallback works, an external pause returns to "Preview", a normal 20 s stream does no decoding, and the natural end and failed-download fallback behave as before.

**C's job:** 7 browser rows (stall fallback, external pause, normal 20 s play, end of file, failed download, Stop, Play stops the preview), plus PERF-RES, AUTH, SOURCE-SCOPE and DOC-252, at 1440×900 and 1280×720. The two cases a browser cannot trigger are covered by A's unit tests only, and C notes that in its report.

**Consults:**
- **Advisor:** available, and I used it three times.
- **tech-lead:** pushed back on the NotAllowedError change and suggested only acting on a stall when the play position hasn't moved.
- **performance-optimizer:** suggested resetting the timer while bytes arrive and which numbers C should assert.
- **product-designer:** not consulted, because this is a perf/bug-fix round with no new user-visible feature.

**Architecture:** the code-reviewer's and the gate reviewer's restructuring proposals are recorded as backlog signals, not scheduled. I've asked root for a bounded frontend-architect checkpoint once the last PERF-13c stage (PERF-13c-ii-b) passes (`b-round-393/root-request-arch-checkpoint-preview.md`).

**Next:** PERF-13c-ii-b, which needs the purchased-track version of this; its browser half will need stubs because the cloud has no backend. Then PERF-13d → PERF-14 → PERF-15 → STEM-LANES → STORE-2b…5 and the rest of the queue. The regression round is due on or after 2026-11-10, and the RETRO is at round 400.
